arStrings.szText: Since coming ashore, I had been anxious to apply for access to the Imperial Library. Few indeed are accepted, so imagine my surprise when their doors opened wide...the moment I uttered the name, “Cain.”
It seems that even after two hundred years, Jered Cain and his Horadrim still hold sway here. A good sign, considering I aim to find the truth of their tales...and perhaps my place in them.
Jered often wrote of a “vault of dangerous wonders” hidden in the Shassar Sea. Thanks to these topographic maps, I may know just where to look.
